title.narrative: Climate Tech Private Equity Trust: Strategic Roadmap and Investor Market Sounding

description.narrative: The Climate Tech Private Equity Trust (PE Trust) is an initiative designed to bolster the growth and scalability of climate tech startups in Thailand. This project is part of Thailand's Green Climate Fund (GCF) Readiness Program and supports Kasikornbank's (KBank) ongoing accreditation process with the GCF. The PE Trust aims to fill a critical gap in Thailand's startup ecosystem by providing early-stage seed funding to climate tech startups, focusing on sectors with high greenhouse gas (GHG) reduction potential, such as energy, transport, and agriculture. Additionally, the PE Trust will prioritize gender equity by supporting women entrepreneurs and promoting diversity within the startup ecosystem. To achieve these objectives, the project will develop a comprehensive Climate Tech Startups Roadmap, outlining clear pathways for startups to navigate funding opportunities, regulatory requirements, and available support mechanisms. The roadmap will be informed by stakeholder consultations and a thorough analysis of the current landscape, identifying key barriers and opportunities for climate tech startups in Thailand. Alongside this, the project will conduct a market sounding exercise to gauge the interest of potential co-investors, aiming to secure initial investment commitments that will ensure the financial sustainability of the PE Trust.
